The else arm runs only if the private `seen` mutex is poisoned, i.e. a thread panicked while holding it. It is locked only inside insert_fresh, whose critical section (retain, len, entry/insert on a map capped at CAPACITY) has no panicking operation. Kept so a poisoned guard fails closed by refusing the 0-RTT attempt.

The else arm runs only if the private `tickets` mutex is poisoned. It is locked only in len, put and take, none of which can panic while holding it: same[0] is read only when same.len() >= PER_SERVER, remove(0) only when len >= CAPACITY, and take removes an index returned by rposition. Kept so a poisoned store drops the ticket instead of panicking.
